name: a bare host with a real top-level domain
why: A renderer autolinks a host with no scheme in front of it, so this fact reaches the page as an off-site link. A fact writes a link as [text](url) and in no other form; a filename or a host in its prose goes in backticks, where a renderer puts the characters on the page and links nothing.
fails: writes a link in a form this snapshot does not read
